sentences.en: The vaccination left a funny little mark on my arm.
sentences.zh: 接种在我手臂上留下了一个小小的印记。

sentences.en: One of the project's targets is vaccinations for women and children.
sentences.zh: 该项目的目标之一是为妇女和儿童提供疫苗接种。

sentences.en: My grandparents have smallpox vaccination scars on their arms.
sentences.zh: 我的祖父母的手臂上有天花接种留下的疤痕。
